name: Algo Four XL
notes: After the Yamaha DX100 Owner's Manual: 8 voices (1 = mono), 4 operators, algorithm 1..8, op 4 feedback. Per operator: ratio (st) + detune (ct) + octave, level, envelope (r1 AR, r2 D1R to l2 D1L, r3 D2R to l3, r4 RR), velocity, level and rate scaling, AM switch, EG bias. LFO: wave, speed, delay, sync, PMD, AMD, PMS, AMS. Wheel and breath (= aftertouch) to pitch and amp, breath pitch bias and EG bias, bend range (oct), portamento (full / fingered), footswitch (FX button or CC 80: sustain or portam
